format: posting pasted from a PDF: hard wraps split skill names across lines
note: R2.3 joins a physical line to the previous one when the previous line has no terminal punctuation and the line starts lower-case. Joined splits: 'root cause / analysis', 'statistical process / control', 'geometric / dimensioning and tolerancing', 'tolerance / stack-up analysis', 'composite / materials'. Not joined (next line starts upper-case): 'Six Sigma Green / Belt' (Six Sigma still matches on line 1) and 'CATIA / V5' (CATIA still matches; it is in Preferred anyway). Spans across a wrap must contain the newline and nothing else (offset invariant). 'Position Summary' and 'Physical Demands' are not vocabulary and fail R2.2 rule 4: body text. 'Essential Functions' is responsibilities vocabulary. AS9100 evidence must be the required-tier line, not the earlier intro.
posting_text:
Quality Engineer – Aerostructures
Cascade Aero Components, Wichita, KS

Position Summary
Cascade Aero Components manufactures machined and bonded structures for commercial
and defense aircraft. The Quality Engineer supports first article inspection and
corrective action for our AS9100 certified facility.

Essential Functions
- Lead root cause
analysis and corrective action for nonconformances using 8D and fishbone
diagrams
- Build and maintain statistical process
control charts for critical characteristics
- Perform first article inspections and review drawings for geometric
dimensioning and tolerancing errors

Minimum Qualifications
- B.S. in Mechanical, Aerospace, or Manufacturing Engineering
- 3+ years of quality engineering experience in an AS9100 environment
- Working knowledge of design FMEA and process FMEA
- Experience with tolerance
stack-up analysis

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience with carbon fiber composite
materials and nondestructive inspection
- Six Sigma Green
Belt or higher
- CMM programming experience; familiarity with CATIA
V5 is a plus

Physical Demands
Work is performed on the shop floor and in an office setting. Must be able to lift
25 pounds.
